ministries.we: Lleva a su iglesia clases de cocina saludable a base de plantas y charlas de salud; también ofrece programas completos para reuniones campestres.
ministries.r: national (says he has presented in every U.S. state)
ministries.note: One presenter, not a team. His site says to book early for camp meetings. Standing rests on the Wisconsin Conference health page listing him among health programs (a link, not a formal endorsement).

ministries.n: Nedley Health – Depression & Anxiety Recovery (Dr. Neil Nedley)
ministries.w: Dr. Neil Nedley speaks at churches on depression, anxiety and the brain; your church can also host his 8-week recovery program.
ministries.we: El Dr. Neil Nedley da charlas en iglesias sobre la depresión, la ansiedad y el cerebro; su iglesia también puede ofrecer su programa de recuperación de 8 semanas.
ministries.r: national (live and virtual events "around the globe")
ministries.note: Use the "Speaker Request Form" linked on the Events page. For the 8-week community program, your own members are trained to lead it (see "Lead a Community Program" on the site).

ministries.n: Uchee Pines Institute – Health Emphasis Weekend
ministries.w: Brings a 1- to 3-day health weekend to your church: 8 laws of health, home remedies with demos, and a cooking school or community health expo.
ministries.we: Lleva a su iglesia un fin de semana de salud de 1 a 3 días: las 8 leyes de la salud, remedios caseros con demostraciones y clases de cocina o una feria de salud.
ministries.r: national ("venues across the country")
ministries.cost: Free-will offering requested, plus permission to sell books and materials on Sunday; travel $0.50 per mile round trip from Uchee Pines, or air travel costs.
ministries.note: Church or group provides accommodations and food for the team.

ministries.n: Wildwood Health Institute – Health Emphasis Weekends (HEWS)
ministries.w: Brings a half-day, full-day or weekend health seminar or expo to your church: talks, cooking school, natural remedies and consultations.
ministries.we: Lleva a su iglesia un seminario o feria de salud de medio día, día completo o fin de semana: charlas, clases de cocina, remedios naturales y consultas.
ministries.who: Wildwood Health Institute (Wildwood, Georgia), a supporting ministry of the Seventh-day Adventist Church
ministries.r: national (travels from Wildwood, Ga.; host pays mileage or airfare)
ministries.cost: No fees. They ask to take a love offering and sell health materials; travel reimbursement ($0.60 per mile or airfare); $500 deposit if a cooking school is included.
ministries.note: Church provides lodging, plant-based meals, local transportation, basic event equipment and the food used in demos. Online application takes 10–20 minutes (or call).

ministries.w: Traveling acrosport gymnastics team giving hour-long shows with anti-drug and anti-bullying messages for youth groups, schools and academy vespers.
ministries.we: Equipo itinerante de gimnasia acrobática con espectáculos de una hora y mensajes contra las drogas y el acoso para grupos juveniles, escuelas y vísperas.
ministries.r: Mostly southern Michigan, northern Indiana and Illinois; has traveled farther
ministries.note: A performance ministry, not a preaching team. Page names youth groups, academies, public-school rallies, and vespers and church services at academies; book a tour by email or phone.

ministries.n: Camp Texico On the Go (traveling day camp)
ministries.w: Conference camp staff bring a Christ-centered day camp to your church: games, activities, worship and Bible lessons for children and families.
ministries.we: El personal del campamento lleva a su iglesia un campamento de día centrado en Cristo: juegos, actividades, culto y lecciones bíblicas para niños y familias.
ministries.who: Texico Conference of Seventh-day Adventists, Youth & Young Adult Ministries
ministries.r: Texico Conference (New Mexico and West Texas)
ministries.note: Summer only.

ministries.w: Lisa Quade leads children's evangelistic programs alongside adult meetings, camp-meeting and VBS programs, and child-evangelism training workshops.
ministries.we: Lisa Quade dirige programas evangelísticos infantiles junto a reuniones de adultos, programas de campestre y EBV, y talleres de evangelismo infantil.
ministries.r: North America and abroad (travels on request)
ministries.note: Use the contact form on its site to invite them. Teaches from the KJV.

ministries.w: Revivals and discipleship training for parents, mentors, teachers and children (e.g., Footprints for Kids, Schools in Discipleship) in your church.
ministries.we: Avivamientos y capacitación en discipulado para padres, mentores, maestros y niños (p. ej., Footprints for Kids, Schools in Discipleship) en su iglesia.
ministries.r: national and international
ministries.cost: No charge for instruction, training, books, resources or meals; at some venues attendees cover their own lodging; love gifts welcome.
ministries.note: Volunteer faith ministry with no paid staff.

ministries.w: Staff-and-student outreach team that trains members, shares literature, gives Bible studies, helps run a reaping series and leads youth vespers.
ministries.we: Equipo de personal y estudiantes que capacita miembros, reparte literatura, da estudios bíblicos, apoya una serie de cosecha y dirige vísperas juveniles.
ministries.who: Pacific Union Conference of Seventh-day Adventists (owns and operates SOULS West)
ministries.r: Pacific Union (Arizona, California, Hawaii, Nevada, Utah)
ministries.cost: Invite page lists 'funding for the program' among what the host church provides; amount not stated.

ministries.w: Sends a Youth Rush student team member to run a youth vespers program at your church, school or Pathfinder club, food included.
ministries.we: Envía a un estudiante de Youth Rush a dirigir un programa de vísperas juvenil en su iglesia, escuela o club de Conquistadores, con comida incluida.
ministries.who: Michigan Conference of Seventh-day Adventists, Literature Ministries Department
ministries.r: Lake Union (outside the Lake Union, case by case)
ministries.cost: FAQ says food is included; no fee stated.
ministries.note: Youth Rush itself is the conference's 10-week summer student literature-evangelism program (early June to mid-August).

ministries.w: Conference department offering marriage and parenting seminars, Family Emphasis Sabbaths, divorce recovery and camp-meeting seminars.
ministries.we: Departamento de la asociación que ofrece seminarios de matrimonio y crianza, sábados de énfasis familiar, recuperación tras el divorcio y seminarios en el campestre.
ministries.r: Carolina Conference (the Carolinas)
ministries.note: Also runs the 'Romance at the Ranch' marriage retreat (February, Nosoca Pines Ranch) and lends resources to families and pastors at no charge.

ministries.w: Conference department that partners with local churches through retreats, seminars and training on marriage, parenting and home life.
ministries.we: Departamento de la asociación que colabora con las iglesias locales mediante retiros, seminarios y capacitación sobre matrimonio, crianza y vida en el hogar.
ministries.r: Michigan Conference
ministries.note: Has a seminar menu (marriage, parenting, money management, faith at home). A Spanish newsletter is offered.

ministries.w: Division family department; its directors can be invited to speak on marriage and family, and it links you to your conference family director.
ministries.we: Departamento de familia de la División; se puede invitar a sus directores a hablar sobre matrimonio y familia, y le conecta con el director de familia de su asociación.
ministries.who: North American Division of Seventh-day Adventists
ministries.r: national (North American Division)
ministries.note: The NAD’s family directors are usually booked 12–15 months ahead; invite nearby churches or plan an area-wide event.

ministries.n: Northern New England Conference Family Ministries
ministries.w: Conference family team that preaches Sabbath sermons and leads family weekends and marriage enrichment seminars at churches.
ministries.we: Equipo de familia de la asociación que predica en el culto de sábado y dirige fines de semana familiares y seminarios de enriquecimiento matrimonial en las iglesias.
ministries.who: Northern New England Conference of Seventh-day Adventists
ministries.r: Northern New England Conference
ministries.note: The page says to contact them early because the calendar fills quickly.

ministries.w: Missionary speakers for weekend mission-promotion events, and trainers for weekend or week-long disciple-making training at your church.
ministries.we: Misioneros para eventos de promoción misionera de fin de semana y capacitadores para entrenamientos de discipulado de un fin de semana o una semana en su iglesia.
ministries.cost: Weekend mission-promotion events: church covers travel, room and board (a donation to AFM is appreciated). Training events: travel, room and board; registration fees case by case. Consulting: $1,000 per day per trainer.
ministries.note: The FAQ says to call the AFM training department (number above) or email; the online interest form is 'coming soon'. Main office 269-473-4250, toll-free 800-937-4236. Request page:

ministries.w: The church's international radio ministry; a staff member or volunteer can come and speak about AWR's mission at your church or event.
ministries.we: Ministerio radial internacional de la Iglesia; un empleado o voluntario puede visitar su iglesia o evento para hablar sobre la misión de AWR.
ministries.note: Its events page says to contact AWR if you would like a staff member or volunteer to speak at your church.

ministries.n: Creation Study Center (North Pacific Union Conference)
ministries.w: Dr. Stan Hudson brings a creation-and-flood seminar (dinosaurs, fossils, age of the earth) to your church; hands-on museum in Ridgefield, WA.
ministries.we: El Dr. Stan Hudson ofrece en su iglesia un seminario sobre la creación y el diluvio (dinosaurios, fósiles, edad de la tierra); museo en Ridgefield, WA.
ministries.who: North Pacific Union Conference of Seventh-day Adventists
ministries.r: North Pacific Union territory (Alaska, Idaho, Montana, Oregon, Washington)
ministries.cost: No charge for churches in the Pacific Northwest; the church pays only for advertising (usually through SermonView).
ministries.note: This is a speaker's seminar, not a walk-through exhibit. Usually a weekend (Friday night and Sabbath) or a one-day series in 3 or 4 parts; book early because the schedule fills up.

ministries.w: Sends a team for a Sabbath mission program at your church: a 50-minute multimedia worship presentation plus an afternoon Q&A.
ministries.we: Envía un equipo para un programa misionero de sábado en su iglesia: una presentación multimedia de 50 minutos en el culto y una sesión de preguntas por la tarde.
ministries.r: United States only (per the invite page)
ministries.cost: No offering is taken and the church has no financial obligation; they appreciate Sabbath lunch for the team.
ministries.note: Request by the online form on the invite page; in-person or virtual programs, and the format can be adjusted.

ministries.w: Division literature ministries department; preaching and seminar appointments on sharing Christian literature are available upon request.
ministries.we: Departamento de ministerios de publicaciones de la División; ofrece predicaciones y seminarios sobre cómo compartir literatura cristiana, a solicitud.
ministries.who: North American Division of Seventh-day Adventists
ministries.r: national (North American Division)

ministries.w: Division stewardship directors give stewardship presentations at churches, such as for a Stewardship Day, on request.
ministries.we: Los directores de mayordomía de la División dan presentaciones sobre mayordomía en las iglesias, por ejemplo para un Día de la Mayordomía, a solicitud.
ministries.who: North American Division of Seventh-day Adventists
ministries.r: national (North American Division)
ministries.note: The request form asks for dates, event type and address. NAD asks you to discuss plans with your pastor and let your conference know.

ministries.n: Walla Walla University Center for Bible, Faith, and Mission
ministries.w: Theology professors speak at churches on Adventist history, beliefs and Bible prophecy; church leaders can request a speaker.
ministries.we: Profesores de teología hablan en las iglesias sobre historia adventista, creencias y profecía bíblica; los líderes de iglesia pueden solicitar un orador.
ministries.who: Walla Walla University School of Theology
